---
title: "9. Spectrum and harmonics"
subtitle: "Move from a periodic waveform to distortion metrics"
julia:
  env: ["JULIA_PROJECT=../../../AmberMakie/docs"]
---

```{julia}
#| include: false
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(joinpath(@__DIR__, "../../../AmberMakie/docs"))
using Amber, AmberMakie, CairoMakie
CairoMakie.activate!()
set_theme!(theme_amber_light())
```

Spectrum analysis starts with an ordinary transient result. The example drives
an RC filter with a pulse train, then uses the settled part of the waveform for
the FFT so startup does not dominate the result.

```{julia}
@circuit MakiePulseFilter() begin
    gnd = ground()
    input = node()
    output = node()
    Source = voltage_source(input, gnd;
        waveform=Pulse(low=0V, high=1V, frequency=10kHz,
            duty_cycle=0.35, rise=1μs, fall=1μs))
    R1 = resistor(input, output; value=1kΩ)
    C1 = capacitor(output, gnd; value=10nF)
end

transient_result = transient(MakiePulseFilter(), 0s => 2ms;
    saveat=0.5μs, max_step=0.5μs)
settled_interval = 500μs => 2ms
spectral = spectrum(transient_result;
    signal=:output, window=:hann, interval=settled_interval)
harmonics = harmonic_analysis(transient_result;
    signal=:output, fundamental=10kHz, harmonics=10,
    interval=settled_interval);
```

```{julia}
figure = Figure(size=(1100, 540))
spectrumplot(figure[1, 1], spectral;
    frequency_scale=:log, include_dc=false, fundamental=10kHz,
    color="#0072B2")
harmonicplot(figure[1, 2], harmonics)
Label(figure[0, :], "Filtered pulse train: spectrum and harmonics"; fontsize=20)
figure
```

The harmonic result carries measurements as data, rather than text scraped
from a plot.

```{julia}
(
    thd_percent=100harmonics.thd,
    sinad_db=harmonics.sinad,
    sfdr_db=harmonics.sfdr,
    reported_harmonics=length(harmonics.harmonics),
)
```

Changing `scale` on `spectrumplot` switches among RMS amplitude, PSD, dBV,
dBFS, and dBm. The underlying `SpectrumResult` is unchanged.
